description: Compute the assistive-tech facts for an element in the session's tab: computed accessible name (always a string; "" means the tree computed no name), computed role, resolved aria-* attributes, plus nearest-landmark and nearest-focusable-ancestor context (each present only when such an ancestor exists; the element itself is never its own focusable ancestor). Use this BEFORE proposing an aria-label / role fix — an outerHTML snippet does not tell you what AT users actually hear, and the element may already be labelled by an ancestor.

cssSelector.description: CSS selector identifying the element to inspect. Prefer the `cssSelector` field on a scan failure (full, untruncated) over `cssSelectorTail` (display-truncated to 120 chars and may begin with `…`, so it is not a valid selector for arbitrary inputs). Constructing a selector yourself from `outerHTMLHead` is also fine.

name: audioeye_get_a11y_facts
title: Get accessibility facts
